name: Player's House (565 Boylston St)
dialogue: Welcome back, Explorer! Here's a hug and fresh snacks for your pocket — all your hearts are restored!
Step through the front door into our house to check the kitchen snack jar, outfit closet, bookshelf secrets, and D&D basement!

name: Parker & Boylston Crosswalk
dialogue: Great job walking along the sidewalk to the Route 9 crosswalk!
Remember: always Look Both Ways before stepping off the curb — you can't climb over the highway barrier!

name: 575 Boylston Plaza
dialogue: Hi neighbor! Right next door to Home Base — watch for cars backing out of the little parking lot!
Here's a fresh band-aid and pocket first-aid kit — all your hearts are patched right up!

name: Oakdale Woods Trailhead
dialogue: Welcome to Oakdale Woods! Rustle the tall grass along the trail to spot lucky acorns and neighborhood coins!

name: Weeks Field & Courts
dialogue: Great job crossing safely! Weeks Field has basketball courts, soccer fields, and is the best shortcut north to Newton Centre!

name: Andover Newton Hill (Trask Library)
dialogue: You climbed all the way up Herrick Road Hill! From here you can head northwest to Newton Centre or south back to Boylston Street.

name: Wilson Chapel
dialogue: Welcome to Wilson Chapel on the hilltop! Listen closely and you can hear bells echoing toward Weeks Field.

name: Crystal Lake Beach & Bathhouse
dialogue: Welcome to Crystal Lake! Feel the warm golden beach sand and shimmering blue water!
Take a Crystal Lake Swim Pass — remember never to swim without a grown-up!

name: Rosenfeld's Bagels (Kosher Bakery)
dialogue: Fresh warm challah and sesame bagels straight out of the oven — have a bite to restore your hearts!
Take a warm paper bag for your delivery errand — careful at the Centre Street crosswalks!

name: Newton Centre Square (First Baptist)
dialogue: You're right in the heart of Newton Centre Square where Beacon Street meets Centre Street!
J.P. Licks and Newtonville Books are just east on Langley Road, and Crystal Lake is right down to the southwest!

name: J.P. Licks Ice Cream Shoppe
dialogue: Welcome to J.P. Licks in Newton Centre! Cookies 'n' Cream or Mint Chocolate Chip?
Here's a Double Scoop Waffle Cone — restores +3 hearts for super explorer energy!

name: Newtonville Books
dialogue: Welcome to Newtonville Books in Newton Centre! Have you found the secret Little Free Library near Oakdale Woods yet?
Here's a golden Explorer Bookmark for your adventures!

name: Newton Centre Playground & The Hut
dialogue: Welcome to the Newton Centre Playground by The Hut! Shoot some hoops or play on the swings right here on the park turf!

name: Newton Fire Station #3 & HQ
dialogue: Welcome to Newton Fire Headquarters! Our shiny red fire engines love when kids look both ways at crosswalks!
You earned a Junior Firefighter Helmet sticker!

name: Newton Highlands (Anna's Taqueria)
dialogue: Bienvenidos to Newton Highlands Village on Lincoln Street!
Grab a warm quesadilla snack (+2 hearts!) before heading north toward Crystal Lake or the Library!

name: St. Paul's Parish (Walnut St)
dialogue: Walnut Street runs straight north from Newton Highlands right toward Newton Free Library!

name: Dunkin' on Boylston St
dialogue: You hiked all the way west along Route 9! Grab a Munchkin box (+2 hearts!) for the walk back!

name: Newton Free Library
dialogue: You made it all the way to the Newton Free Library!
Check the outdoor pickup lockers and Little Free Library chest for rare book stamps!

name: Bullough's Pond Overlook
dialogue: Welcome to Bullough's Pond! Watch the ducks splash in the shallow shoreline water!

name: Congregation Beth El-Atereth Israel
dialogue: Shabbat Shalom! Try Dad's Spicy Cholent (+2 hearts & snacks!) for explosive explorer energy!
Take this Pocket Siddur too — press K (or tap 📖 Siddur) to dispel spooky ghosts & graveyard monsters!

name: Congregation Shaarei Tefillah
dialogue: Shalom, Explorer! Welcome to Congregation Shaarei Tefillah on Morseland Avenue!
Take this Pocket Siddur — press K (or tap 📖 Siddur) to shine a peaceful blessing that dispels bad guys!

name: Temple Emanuel
dialogue: Welcome to Temple Emanuel on Ward Street! Head east down Ward Street to reach Ward Elementary Baseball Field!
Take a Pocket Siddur too — press K (or tap 📖 Siddur) whenever you need to dispel bad guys!

name: Chabad of Newton Centre
dialogue: Shalom, Explorer! Have some warm honey cake (+2 hearts!) and take a Pocket Siddur to dispel bad guys (press K)!

name: Ward Elementary Baseball Field
dialogue: Step up to the plate for batting practice or test the backyard trebuchet across the outfield!

name: The Mall at Chestnut Hill
dialogue: Whoa — you explored all the way east down Route 9 to Chestnut Hill!
Wegmans is right across the highway to the south!

name: The Salzberg Family Home (200 Cotton St)
dialogue: Hey Liam! Welcome to 200 Cotton Street — right next to the spooky 1660 graveyard!
Take our Co-Op Explorer Badge AND this Explorer's Graveyard Sword — press J (or tap ⚔️ Sword) to fight graveyard skeletons, phantoms & ghosts!

name: Bella & Sydney's Family (Morton Circle)
dialogue: Hi Liam! You found your way all the way to Morton Circle!
So glad you came over to hang out — take this Morton Circle Friendship Bracelet!

name: Boston College Law Campus (Stuart Hall)
dialogue: Go Eagles! Welcome to Boston College's Newton Campus — home of Stuart Hall, Cushing Hall, Duchesne Hall, and the BC Law Library!
Cross Centre Street carefully to the east if you're brave enough to visit the spooky 1660 East Parish Burying Ground!

name: Boston College — Messina Campus
dialogue: Welcome to Boston College's Messina Campus along Hammond Pond Parkway!
Take this BC Gold Explorer Notebook for your campus journal!

name: East Parish Burying Ground (1660)
dialogue: Booo-jour, brave Explorer! Welcome to Newton's oldest 1660 graveyard — right across Centre Street from Boston College!
Don't worry, our floating ghosts, black cats, and glowing pumpkins are super friendly — take this Spooky Lantern!

name: Newton Cemetery & Arboretum
dialogue: Hoo-hoo! Welcome to Newton Cemetery & Arboretum on Walnut Street!
Watch for floating ghosts drifting over the misty pond, flapping bats in the gnarled oaks, and glowing Jack-o'-Lanterns by the stone crypts!
